name: Seiyoku Gakuen Seraphita
source:
Futanari Rei transfers to an all-girl school to seduce all the pretty girls in the local student dormitory.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-february-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
